verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's annual-report page states its coverage: it files annual reports automatically in all states as they come due. The only published prices are for the separate registered-agent service ($99 first year, $159 renewal, multi-year lock-in), so they do not show what the filing service costs. missing for 10: published pricing for the annual-report filing service, a per-state or per-filing-type coverage list beyond the 'all states' claim, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it

citations.quote: We file annual reports automatically in all states as they come due.
